name: Tobuuy
summary:
Tobuuy is a free economic board game for 2 to 8 players that runs in the web browser. Players buy properties, upgrade them up to a hotel and try to drive their opponents into bankruptcy; the last player who is not bankrupt wins. A host creates a room and shares the link, and other players join without an account or download. Empty seats can be filled with computer opponents in three difficulty levels.

Special rules include the Crown, which makes rent on a crowned property also cost a share of the payer's net worth, Angel and Devil cards that either help the player or attack a rival's property, a third die, the fate die, that makes either the bank or the player pay, and buying out a rival's property after paying rent on it. The game has six 3D maps with day, night and winter variants, boards with 32, 40 or 48 tiles, a tutorial and a streamer mode with a waiting list for viewers. It is available in German and English.
